preconditions: Lists YOUR tenant's signals. The matched-partner Discover feed is GET /api/network/signals (gated server-side).

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.
